senses.gloss: m. (פְּתַח) [opening,] preliminary legal proceeding, esp. summons to appear before, or to obey the decision of the court under penalty of excommunication; warrant.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 31b:4">R. Hash. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כתב פ׳ עילווה</he> (Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="Q00905"><he>פיתקא</he></cite>) he wrote a warrant out against her.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 112b:9-10">B. Kam. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>נטרינן ליה … פתיחה עילויה וכ׳</he> we wait for him a Monday and a Thursday and another Monday; if he does not appear, we write a warrant against him, giving him ninety days &c.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 112b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>והני מילי לשמתא אבל לפ׳ וכ׳</he> this is the case with reference to decreeing excommunication, but for writing a warrant (at the defendant’s expense) it is not so (the court messenger’s statement is not so valid as the testimony of two).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:6">Ib. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דכתיב עליה פ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דנקיט</he>) if a warrant has been issued against a person; a. e.
